name: Draconic Terror
body:
You draconic heritage inspires fear, and you know how to exploit that.

Prerequisite: Wyvaran

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on all Intimidate skill checks, and you add a +1 to the DC of all fear spells that you cast.

Book of Heroic Races: Advanced Wyvarans © 2015, Jon Brazer Enterprises.
